hierarchical_skill_representation.requirement_levels: Skill Level Requirements Module gives one required level per required resource/skill role.
hierarchical_skill_representation.resource_levels: Workforce Module with Skill Levels gives each resource's level for each skill.

steps: parse every canonical MSLIB1-4 .msrcp source using only source-native data
join official workbook network/resource/skill indicators where canonical rows exist
standardize configured source indicators within each MSLIB set, with log1p on scale variables
seed selection with medoids of the most frequent categorical source-parameter groups
fill remaining slots by farthest-first maximin distance in standardized source space

audit_rows.definition: Total project activities including dummy start and dummy end.
audit_rows.provenance: Project Module header in .msrcp source file.
audit_rows.reason: Direct source scale field, not a solution result.

audit_rows.definition: Non-dummy activity count, total activities minus dummy start/end.
audit_rows.provenance: Deterministically derived from Project Module header and dummy-node convention.
audit_rows.reason: Defines the MSLIB activity/work-package scale without using objective values.

audit_rows.definition: Number of renewable multi-skilled resources.
audit_rows.provenance: Project Module header in .msrcp source file.

audit_rows.definition: Number of skill types.
audit_rows.provenance: Project Module header in .msrcp source file.

audit_rows.definition: Number of hierarchical skill levels.
audit_rows.provenance: Project Module header in .msrcp source file.

audit_rows.definition: Count of immediate precedence arcs.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived by counting successors in Project Module activity rows.

audit_rows.definition: Immediate precedence arcs divided by possible acyclic ordered pairs.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from parsed precedence arcs and activity count.

audit_rows.definition: Transitive real-activity precedence comparability share.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from transitive closure of parsed precedence DAG.

audit_rows.definition: Longest precedence-only path duration from dummy start to dummy end.
audit_rows.provenance: Independently computed from parsed durations and precedence DAG.
audit_rows.reason: Allowed CP-like quantity because it is recomputed from source structure, not copied from BKS columns.

audit_rows.definition: Maximum number of precedence edges on a path to dummy end.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from parsed precedence DAG.

audit_rows.definition: Mean duration over non-dummy activities.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Project Module activity durations.
audit_rows.reason: Duration distribution summary, not a solved objective.

audit_rows.definition: Population standard deviation of non-dummy activity durations.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Project Module activity durations.

audit_rows.definition: 10th percentile of non-dummy activity durations.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Project Module activity durations.

audit_rows.definition: 90th percentile of non-dummy activity durations.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Project Module activity durations.

audit_rows.definition: Total expanded skill/resource requirements over non-dummy activities.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Skill Requirements Module multiplicities.

audit_rows.definition: Mean expanded role multiplicity over non-dummy activities.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Skill Requirements Module multiplicities.

audit_rows.definition: Population standard deviation of expanded role multiplicity over non-dummy activities.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Skill Requirements Module multiplicities.

audit_rows.definition: Mean mastered skills per resource.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Workforce Module with Skill Levels.

audit_rows.definition: Population standard deviation of mastered skills per resource.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Workforce Module with Skill Levels.

audit_rows.definition: Mean positive resource skill level.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Workforce Module with Skill Levels.

audit_rows.definition: Mean required level over expanded activity roles.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Skill Level Requirements Module.

audit_rows.definition: One minus normalized entropy of skill-demand counts.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Skill Requirements Module.

audit_rows.definition: One minus normalized entropy of resource skill-supply counts.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from Workforce Module with Skill Levels.

audit_rows.definition: Cosine similarity between source skill demand and source skill supply.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source demand and supply counts.

audit_rows.definition: Zipf-like slope proxy estimated from source skill-supply concentration.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source skill supply counts.

audit_rows.definition: Total expanded source roles divided by source resources.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source requirements and resource count.

audit_rows.definition: Mean inverse directly qualified resource count per role, with unqualified roles treated as maximally scarce.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source role levels and workforce levels.

audit_rows.definition: Share of source roles with at least one directly qualified resource.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source role levels and workforce levels.

audit_rows.definition: Share of source roles with at least one resource exactly one level below requirement.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source role levels and workforce levels.

audit_rows.definition: Share of source roles with both a one-below resource and a directly qualified potential mentor.
audit_rows.provenance: Derived from source role levels and workforce levels.
audit_rows.reason: Source hierarchical mentorship-potential measure, not an algorithm result.

audit_rows.definition: Coefficient of Network Complexity.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Network Topology.

audit_rows.definition: Order Strength.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Network Topology.

audit_rows.definition: Serial-Parallel Network Indicator.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Network Topology.

audit_rows.definition: Skill Factor.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Skill Parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Skill Factor Variability.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Skill Parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Skill Strength.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Skill Parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Skill Strength Variability.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Skill Parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Resource availability.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Resource parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Resource availability variability.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Resource parameters.

audit_rows.definition: Best lower bound found by CPLEX within the time limit (linear relaxation).
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Best Known Solutions.
audit_rows.reason: Solution/BKS information must remain provenance/diagnostic only.

audit_rows.definition: Best known solution.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Best Known Solutions and algorithm result sections.
audit_rows.reason: Best-known objective values cannot influence source selection.

audit_rows.definition: Closed if best found lower bound equals best found upper bound across procedures; otherwise open.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Best Known Solutions.
audit_rows.reason: Solved/open status depends on lower and upper bounds from solution procedures.

audit_rows.definition: Critical path based lower bound.
audit_rows.provenance: Official workbook Parameter Overview, Fast lower bounds.
audit_rows.reason: Workbook CP is not selected; Type 6 uses independently recomputed critical_path_length from the parsed DAG instead.

selection_audit.critical_path_selection_source: critical_path_length is independently computed from the parsed precedence DAG; the workbook CP lower-bound column is not used.

source_format_interpretation.optional_modules: Cost, common resource usage, and rework modules are parsed as available source metadata only for later phases.
source_format_interpretation.project_module: Header is number of activities including dummy start/end, renewable multi-skilled resources, skill types, and skill levels; the next two singleton lines are BKS/basic and deadline/provenance values; then one activity row per node contains duration, successor count, and successor ids.
source_format_interpretation.skill_level_requirements_module: One row per activity; dummy rows are -1. For non-dummy activities, level entries are expanded in skill order according to the multiplicities in the Skill Requirements Module.
source_format_interpretation.workforce_level_module: Resource-skill level matrix with 0 for unmastered skills and positive levels 1..L for mastered skills.
source_format_interpretation.workforce_module: Binary resource-skill mastery matrix with one row per resource and one column per skill.
